name: Contractor inquiry-to-estimate follow-up (incomplete synthetic demo)
end_point: The first estimate follow-up is completed

source_messages.speaker: owner
source_messages.text: This is a fictional contractor business for a course demo. I do not know how many estimate cases we handle per month. The steps run sequentially for one representative case. Waiting minutes are elapsed time before work on the current step, inside the process boundaries, including nights and weekends. Hourly rates are labor costs per person, not customer billing rates. I have reviewed only the receive-inquiry inputs; the remaining known values are still drafts.

source_messages.speaker: owner
source_messages.text: Step 1: Receive inquiry. Responsible role: Office administrator. Active work takes 10 minutes per case. Waiting before work on this step takes 0 minutes per case. The number of people actively working is 1. Labor cost per person is USD 30.00 per hour.

source_messages.speaker: owner
source_messages.text: Step 2: Collect job details. Responsible role: Estimator. Active work takes 15 minutes per case. Waiting before work on this step takes 120 minutes per case. The number of people actively working is 1. Labor cost per person is USD 45.00 per hour.

source_messages.speaker: owner
source_messages.text: Step 3: Visit job site. Responsible role: Site assessment crew. Active work takes 60 minutes per case. I do not know the waiting time after the site visit. The number of people actively working is 2. Labor cost per person is USD 40.00 per hour.

source_messages.speaker: owner
source_messages.text: Step 4: Prepare estimate. Responsible role: Estimator. I do not know how long preparing an estimate takes. Waiting before work on this step takes 240 minutes per case. The number of people actively working is 1. I do not know the estimator's hourly labor cost.

source_messages.speaker: owner
source_messages.text: Step 5: Send estimate. Responsible role: Office administrator. Active work takes 5 minutes per case. Waiting before work on this step takes 0 minutes per case. The number of people actively working is 1. Labor cost per person is USD 30.00 per hour.

source_messages.speaker: owner
source_messages.text: Step 6: Follow up on estimate. I do not know who is responsible. Active work takes 10 minutes per case. Waiting before work on this step takes 2880 minutes per case. I do not know how many people handle the follow-up. I do not know the follow-up staff's hourly labor cost.
